Locin had an approved Bradenhead plan (document #403142960). Locin conducted another test July 12th, 2024 to see if this plan lowered pressures, but it did not. During the bradenhead test we can see that the production casing pressure stays constant throughout the test showing us there is no communication between the production and surface casing. There is still the issue of the pressure being too high (more than 30% of the surface casing depth). A solution that we can implement to monitor and control that high pressure is to blow down the pressure once every month to keep it under the pressure required by the ruling. This well will be scheduled for plugging and abandonment in 2025.
